task: Escribe 6 a 8 frases sobre un vecino, un compañero o un amigo: cómo lo conociste y qué hacen juntos.
paragraphs: When Mrs Clark moved into the flat next to mine, I was a bit worried. She was about seventy-five, she lived alone, and on the first day she didn't say hello to anyone.

A week later, I heard a loud noise from her flat. I knocked on her door and asked if she was OK. She opened the door with a smile. "I'm fine, dear," she said. "I'm just trying to move my piano!" I helped her, and she made me a cup of tea.

That afternoon I learned a lot about her. She was a music teacher for forty years and she travelled all over the world with an orchestra. She speaks French and Italian, and she still plays the piano every day.

Now we see each other almost every weekend. She is teaching me to play the piano, and I help her with her shopping and her computer. Last Sunday she cooked lunch for all the neighbours in our building. Everyone came, even Mr Davis from the top floor, who never talks to anybody.
Mrs Clark is the best neighbour I have ever had. I was wrong to worry!
